items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: They would put everything wrote by the Cats and the Fiddle... I wrote a lot of stuff. And I arranged all that those that was arranged.

ctx.x: And played it, played the hell out of it, 4 strings -- he played it. And that made me wanna play that much worse, ha, ha. He was a nice cat. He was tickled at me for the 4 strings. He said, "man why don't you get yourself six strings". I say, "I can hardly play these four, no sense of six." He played it all right, old Gibson I had. But he could play, I got some tapes around here. Dan Morgenstern has got the tapes. He's got the records --
Q. Cats and the Fiddle record dates, Songs composed by TG

Those guys had a thing of doing that I didn't know anything about. See, they were together, they started off together before I joined them. They would put everything wrote by the Cats and the Fiddle. Me, I don't know what did I know. If I was smart, if I had somebody to tell me ... but I made them all get a share, but I still never got a share. Red Buttons say, "Ain't never got a dinner."
